figures.name: 01 Human rights index, world regions, 1923-2023
figures.image_subtitle: Expert estimates of government torture, political killings, and forced labor; property rights; and freedoms of movement, religion, expression, and association. The index ranges from 0 to 1 (most rights).
figures.identification: The image is a line chart of the six continents from 1923 to 2023, source V-Dem (2024); the page links the chart human-rights-index-vdem, whose regional series (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, South America) it shows. The ground truth is the chart's current data (decision 0003).
